evidence.title: Inception-style curved map for turn-by-turn directions

summary: A new navigation interface displays routes on a three‑dimensional, curved map reminiscent of the folding cityscapes from the film Inception, aiming to make directions easier to follow. The feature, built on recent advances in AI-driven map rendering, is being rolled out to users of major navigation apps later this month.
title: AI-Powered 'Inception'-Style Curved Map Introduced for Turn‑by‑Turn Navigation
